mapper.select: SELECT * FROM public.nocode_application_access WHERE application_id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.nocode_application_access(application_id, lock_version, policy_json, creator, updater) VALUES (#{id}, 1, CAST(#{json} AS jsonb), #{actor}, #{actor}) ON CONFLICT(application_id) DO UPDATE SET policy_json = EXCLUDED.policy_json, lock_version = nocode_application_access.lock_version + 1, updater = #{actor}, update_time = clock_timestamp()
